beat: Painting: Sunday horror plan, promised movie, tiring stool work and lunch

lines.original: Dhika: Chotu, you know, tonight I am going for a movie.... the new horror one... did you see it yet ?
lines.local: Dhika: Chotu, pata hai aaj raat main movie dekhne jaa rahi hoon—woh nayi horror waali. Tumne dekhi?

lines.original: Chotu: aahh movie.... feeling little sad, I haven't seen movie in a long time didi....
lines.local: Chotu halka udaas hokar: Oh... movie. Maine kaafi time se koi film nahi dekhi, didi.

lines.original: Dhika: ohhh... recognizing she should not have asked him....she felt bad too...'
lines.local: Dhika ko turant laga ki yeh sawaal nahi poochhna chahiye tha. Use bhi bura mehsoos hua.

lines.original: Chotu doesn't have the luxury of spending money in theaters often or even if he had money saved,..... he didn't have any friends in the city to watch a movie with him.... All he knows, who belongs to his age, is the two girls who are working with him. But, the chances of them joining him for a movie and Kajal Agarwal being the real Dhika were one and the same....
lines.local: Chotu ke paas baar-baar theatre jaane ka budget nahi tha; aur paise bacha bhi leta, toh shehar mein saath jaane waale dost nahi the. Uski umr ke jin logon ko woh jaanta tha, woh uske saath kaam karne waali do ladkiyaan thin; unka saath movie jaana utna hi unlikely tha jitna Kajal Agarwal ka asal mein Dhika hona.

lines.original: Dhika: smiling politely.... Chotu dear.... would you like to go to a movie with me someday?
lines.local: Dhika pyaar se muskurayi: Chotu dear, kisi din mere saath movie dekhne chaloge?

lines.original: Chotu: Feeling happy like a child.... yes... yes didi.... I don't have anyone here to go to a movie with.
lines.local: Chotu bahut khush: Haan! Haan didi! Yahan mere saath movie jaane waala koi nahi hai.

lines.original: Dhika: smiling.... say you what..... when we finish painting this room... we both will go and enjoy any movie you like...
lines.local: Dhika: Toh pakka—jab yeh room paint ho jaayega, hum dono tumhari pasand ki koi bhi movie dekhne jaayenge.

lines.original: Chotu: yessss.... I will keep checking what good movie is coming..hehe
lines.local: Chotu: Yes! Main check karta rahunga kaunsi achhi movie aa rahi hai, hehe!
Dhika: Hehe... lekin horror movie akele nahi!

lines.original: The conversation shifted to many things while they painted for next 1 hour.... the work was going really slow for her. Standing on the stool and painting, Dhika felt it really tiring..... and with the stool coverage being small, everytime she had to get down, movie the stool and climb up again... she was starting to get pain in her joints...
lines.local: Agla ek ghanta painting karte hue woh kai baatein karte rahe. Kaam Dhika ke liye bahut dheere ho raha tha: chhote stool par upar paint karna tiring tha; baar-baar neeche utarkar stool khiskaana aur phir chadhna padta tha. Joints mein dard hone laga.

lines.original: Chotu on the other hand, was going slow too....because of the inviting distractions. With Dhika wearing a short skirt and standing on the stool to paint.... Dhika's white milky thighs were distracting Chotu so much, especially when she started sweating. The water forming over her milky skin turned her thighs to shine like a porcelain. It was so difficult to work with a hardon.
lines.local: Chotu ka kaam bhi dheere chal raha tha kyunki dhyaan bhatak raha tha. Dhika chhoti skirt mein stool par khadi thi; uski thighs aur paseene se chamakti skin dekhkar Chotu distract ho raha tha, aur erection ke saath kaam karna mushkil ho gaya.

lines.original: Dhika too noticed a couple of times Chotu stealing quick glances at her thighs.
lines.local: Dhika ne bhi do-ek baar Chotu ko uski thighs ki taraf chori se dekhte notice kiya.

lines.original: At this rate, she felt like they would take atleast 15 total hours to finish the entire work.....
lines.local: Is speed se Dhika ko laga poora kaam khatam hone mein kul kam-se-kam pandrah ghante lagenge.

lines.original: Soon, both were tiring and feeling hungry and so, winded up in the room, went to refresh themselves and met in the kitchen....
lines.local: Jaldi hi dono thak gaye aur bhookh lagne lagi. Painting sametkar fresh hone gaye aur phir kitchen mein mile.

lines.original: Dhika: Food is ready dear... just let me heat the curry...
lines.local: Dhika: Khaana ready hai dear; bas curry garam kar leti hoon.
